label: Week of November 13, 2026
intro: Three options this week: Indian curry bowls from the Instant Pot, a Mediterranean plan with the least effort, and American comfort food with meatloaf muffins and beef chili stew. Each one is a breakfast, two mains that swap between lunch and dinner, and a snack, all made in one prep day.

plans.name: Indian Curry Bowls
plans.blurb: Tikka chicken with chickpeas and turkey with lentils, both from the Instant Pot over one pot of brown rice, with baked oatmeal cups for breakfast.

recipes.name: Berry Baked Oatmeal Cups
recipes.summary: Oats baked with egg whites, milk and chia into soft cups, with warm berries on the side.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 3 months. Wrap each cup in foil; microwave from frozen for 2 minutes.
steps: Stir the oats, egg whites, milk and chia together with a shake of cinnamon for {{bake}}.
Pour into a lined muffin tin or square pan and bake at 180°C (350°F) for 30 minutes.
Cool, cut into portions and add the berries when you eat.

recipes.name: Tikka Chicken & Chickpea Bowl
recipes.summary: Chicken and chickpeas cooked in jarred tikka sauce in the Instant Pot, over brown rice with spinach.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 3 months. Reheats like new; add a splash of water.
steps: Instant Pot: chicken (cut in big chunks), tikka sauce and drained chickpeas for {{curry}}. Lid on, high pressure 8 minutes, natural release.
Shred the chicken in the sauce with two forks.
Rice: cooked together with the other main (see the prep tab).
Each container: rice, curry and a lump of frozen spinach straight from the bag.
notes: Weigh chicken raw; it loses about a fifth of its weight cooking.

recipes.name: Turkey Tikka Lentil Bowl
recipes.summary: Ground turkey and lentils simmered in tikka sauce, over the same brown rice with frozen broccoli.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 3 months. Reheats like new; add a splash of water.
steps: Instant Pot on sauté: brown the turkey, then add the sauce and drained lentils for {{keema}}. Lid on, high pressure 5 minutes.
Rice: cooked together with the other main (see the prep tab).
Each container: rice, turkey lentils and a lump of frozen broccoli straight from the bag.

recipes.name: Spiced Pear Cottage Cheese
recipes.summary: Cottage cheese with a pinch of cinnamon, pumpkin seeds and a pear alongside.
recipes.freezeTip: Dairy and fruit do not freeze well. Keep in the fridge and eat within 5 days.
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into small containers and sprinkle with the seeds.
Keep the pear whole and eat it alongside.

prep.name: Session 1: rice, curries and oatmeal cups

steps.text: Brown rice for both mains: {{A-m1.rice+A-m2.rice}}. Rinse, add water, cook in the Instant Pot, high pressure 22 minutes.
Baked oatmeal: {{A-b.bake}}. Stir together, pour into a lined pan or tin.
Put the pan in the oven at 180°C (350°F).
Rest while the rice and oatmeal cook.
Fluff the rice onto a tray; cool and cut the oatmeal.
Instant Pot: chicken, sauce and chickpeas for {{A-m1.curry}}. Lid on, high pressure 8 minutes.
Rest while it cooks and releases pressure.
Shred the chicken in the pot and decant.
Instant Pot on sauté: brown the turkey, then add sauce and lentils for {{A-m2.keema}}.
Lid on, high pressure 5 minutes.
Rest while it cooks and releases pressure.
At the table with the scale: build each container from the portion card. Frozen spinach and broccoli go in straight from the bag.
Snack cups for the first {{keepDays}} days.
Label: days 1–{{fridgeDays}} fridge, the rest freezer.

plans.name: Mediterranean, Least Effort
plans.blurb: Rotisserie chicken hummus bowls and a Greek chickpea stew over one pot of quinoa. Breakfast is spinach feta egg cups.

recipes.name: Spinach & Feta Egg Cups + Pear
recipes.summary: Egg cups baked with spinach and feta, with a pear alongside.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 3 months. Wrap each cup in foil; microwave from frozen for 2 minutes.
steps: Whisk the eggs and whites, stir in the spinach (thawed in a bowl) and feta for {{cups}}.
Pour into a lined pan or muffin tin and bake at 180°C (350°F) for 25 minutes.
Cool and cut. Eat the pear alongside.

recipes.name: Rotisserie Chicken Hummus Quinoa Bowl
recipes.summary: Pulled rotisserie chicken over quinoa with broccoli and a spoon of hummus.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 3 months. Add the hummus after reheating if you like it cool.
steps: Pull the chicken off the bones; you need {{chicken}}.
Quinoa: cooked together with the other main (see the prep tab).
Each container: quinoa, chicken and a lump of frozen broccoli straight from the bag. Hummus on top.

recipes.name: Greek Chickpea Tomato Stew & Chicken
recipes.summary: Chickpeas, tomatoes and spinach stewed together, served over quinoa with pulled chicken and feta.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 3 months. Reheats like new.
steps: Instant Pot: drained chickpeas, tomatoes with juice and spinach for {{stew}}. High pressure 5 minutes, quick release. Add a shake of oregano.
Quinoa: cooked together with the other main (see the prep tab).
Each container: quinoa, stew and pulled chicken. Add the feta when you eat.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt, Berries & Chia
recipes.summary: Plain Greek yogurt with thawed berries and a sprinkle of chia.
recipes.freezeTip: Yogurt does not freeze well. Keep in the fridge and eat within 5 days.
steps: Spoon the yogurt into small containers, top with berries and chia. Berries thaw in the fridge.

steps.text: Quinoa for both mains: {{B-m1.quinoa+B-m2.quinoa}}. Rinse, add water, cook in the Instant Pot, high pressure 1 minute, natural release.
Egg cups: {{B-b.cups}}. Whisk, stir in spinach and feta, pour into a lined pan.
Put the pan in the oven at 180°C (350°F).
Rest while the quinoa and egg cups cook.
Stew: after the quinoa, tip chickpeas, tomatoes and spinach for {{B-m2.stew}} into the Instant Pot. High pressure 5 minutes.
Rest while it cooks.
Pull the rotisserie chicken apart.
At the table with the scale: build each container from the portion card. Broccoli goes in straight from the bag.
Snack cups for the first {{keepDays}} days.
Label: days 1–{{fridgeDays}} fridge, the rest freezer.

plans.name: American Comfort Food
plans.blurb: Turkey oat meatloaf muffins and beef kidney bean chili stew over one pot of brown rice, with egg breakfast wraps.

recipes.name: Cheddar Egg & Pepper Breakfast Wraps
recipes.summary: Scrambled eggs with pepper strips and cheddar rolled in a whole-wheat tortilla.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 3 months. Wrap each in foil; microwave from frozen for 2 minutes.
steps: Scramble the eggs, whites and pepper strips in a big non-stick pan for {{eggs}}; stir in the cheddar at the end.
Spoon into tortillas and roll up tightly.
Wrap each in foil for the freezer.

recipes.name: Turkey Oat Meatloaf Muffins
recipes.summary: Turkey, oats and marinara baked in muffin tins, with brown rice and broccoli.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 3 months. Reheat from frozen, 3 minutes in the microwave.
steps: Mix the turkey, oats, egg and half the marinara in a bowl by hand for {{loaf}}. Press into a muffin tin.
Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 25 minutes. Top with the rest of the marinara.
Rice: cooked together with the other main (see the prep tab).
Each container: rice, muffins and a lump of frozen broccoli straight from the bag.

recipes.name: Beef & Kidney Bean Chili Stew
recipes.summary: Lean beef, kidney beans, tomatoes and pepper strips cooked in the Instant Pot, over brown rice.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 3 months. Reheats like new.
steps: Instant Pot on sauté: brown the beef, then add the beans, tomatoes and pepper strips for {{stew}}. Lid on, high pressure 8 minutes.
Rice: cooked together with the other main (see the prep tab).
Each container: rice, stew and a handful of frozen corn straight from the bag.

recipes.name: Edamame, Pear & Pumpkin Seeds
recipes.summary: Shelled edamame with pumpkin seeds and a pear alongside.
recipes.freezeTip: Fruit does not freeze well. Keep in the fridge and eat within 5 days.
steps: Thaw the edamame and portion with the seeds.
Keep the pear whole and eat it alongside.

steps.text: Brown rice for both mains: {{C-m1.rice+C-m2.rice}}. Rinse, add water, cook in the Instant Pot, high pressure 22 minutes.
Meatloaf muffins: mix {{C-m1.loaf}} by hand and press into muffin tins.
Put the tins in the oven at 190°C (375°F).
Rest while the rice and muffins cook.
Fluff the rice onto a tray; spoon marinara on the muffins and cool.

prep.name: Session 2: chili stew and breakfast wraps

steps.text: Instant Pot on sauté: brown the beef, then add beans, tomatoes and peppers for {{C-m2.stew}}.
Lid on, high pressure 8 minutes.
Rest while it cooks and releases pressure.
Scramble the eggs for {{C-b.eggs}} and roll into tortillas.
At the table with the scale: build each container from the portion card. Frozen broccoli and corn go in straight from the bag.
Snack cups for the first {{keepDays}} days.
Label: days 1–{{fridgeDays}} fridge, the rest freezer.
